hypothesis: Post-pause added words (p07, p48, p56, p57 x2) are lost because every judge that needs a word's identity reads one model, and that model either cannot spell the word or cannot be trusted alone. Two already-trained ears from outside the shipped lineage each carry these words: the short-crop word ear wrote 6 planted words whole, and the undistilled SSL CTC ear kept 2 or more ordered planted consonants on 5 of 6. Emit an added word only when the SSL ear's seam tokens confirm the exact word the word ear proposed; predict 2 of 5 won with about 1 loss: listener -2, overall -1.
